component.name: Kitsune
component.summary: Private web browser made of paper and ink
Navegador privado de serie, de papel y tinta

description.p: Kitsune is a private-by-default browser built on Gecko, the engine of Firefox: no telemetry, uBlock Origin built in, and a home page that is yours.

ul.li: Spaces, tabs on the side, split view of up to four sites and a command palette
Saver mode: half the memory with twenty sites open
Six inks that change the colors and the shape of the whole browser
Strict and Comfortable privacy modes, and a Kitsune copy to take your things to another computer

description.p: Kitsune es un navegador privado de serie hecho con Gecko, el motor de Firefox: sin telemetría, con uBlock Origin incluido y un inicio que es tuyo.

screenshot.caption: Spaces, tabs on the side and a split view

description.p: Spaces, split view of up to four sites, command palette, inks with shape, saver mode you can see, Kitsune copy and Gecko 158.
